newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan business group urges swift reform of economy.
newsitem.headline: Japan business group urges swift reform of economy.

text.p: Japan's influential business group Keidanren urged Trade Minister Shinji Sato on Thursday to swiftly implement structural reforms of the economy, a trade official said.

Keidanren head Shoichiro Toyoda told Sato in a meeting between Keidanren and officials from the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) that there may not be another chance for such reforms if the government misses the current opportunity, the MITI official said.
Toyoda also said private businesses are willing to cooperate on reforms which may entail some sacrifice on their part, the official told reporters.

Sato in turn promised to implement the reforms as instructed by Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, adding that while Japan's economy is on a gradual recovery path, small firms are not performing as well as large companies and the job market is still tight, the official said.
